messages:
Sam (partnerships): Quick sync — proposing a lightweight 'Tooling Slate' sandbox for ISV/tooling partners (LangChain, LlamaIndex), gateway vendors, orchestration tools, and HW partners to run preflight tests + short demos. Goal: surface integration gaps early and create a repeatable playbook. 3-week window, shared test harness, standard manifests, SSO + billing creds.

Kai (devex): +1. Can we make the onboarding <15m? we should auto-provision test keys and a guided checklist. :rocket:

Raj (eng-runtime): Need to call out kernel/quantization matrix up front. HW partners will want perf by model variant + seq length. I can put together sample configs and a small perf CSV. Also: KV cache behavior can break some LlamaIndex adapters.

Sam (partnerships): Raj — great. Can you target a toy manifest by EOD Wed? it can be minimal: model, seq_len_buckets, quant profile, expected throughput.

Raj (eng-runtime): Yep. Example manifest snippet I'll use for the slate: 

```json
{
  "model": "open/redwood-edge-1",
  "seq_buckets": [128, 512, 2048],
  "quant": "4bit-ptq",
  "latency_slo_ms": 120
}
```

Kai (devex): SSO note — partners want both SP-initiated SAML and OIDC. We should expose a light-weight SSO toggle and a fallback dev-login. Also need to capture the redirect URIs for gateway callbacks.

integrations-bot: Recent automated smoke run (sandbox-v3): A100: 7/10 tests passed, T4: 9/10 passed, ARM-edge: 4/10 passed. Failures are mostly due to memory spikes on long-seq tests. Full report: https://internal/reports/sandbox-v3 (internal)

Emily (product): Marketing wants a co-demo + short blog the week after the slate closes. Legal will need an MSA addendum for the sandbox terms (data retention, logs access). Can partnerships coordinate legal + marketing signoff?

Morgan (bizops): Budget ask — we'll need partner credits (compute) and maybe travel/demo credits for key SI partners. Propose drawing from Q2 partner pool; will submit a request.

Sam (partnerships): Owners proposal: Partnerships own partner invites + comms; DevEx owns onboarding flows + SSO; Eng-runtime owns test harness + manifests; Product owns co-demo plan; BizOps owns credits. Deadlines: manifests by Wed, onboarding flow by next Tue, partner invites out Thurs.

Kai (devex): I can scaffold the onboarding guide. Quick smoke command we can surface in docs: 

```bash
# gateway smoke test
curl -s -X POST https://sandbox.redwood.ai/gateway/test -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"prompt":"hello","model":"open/redwood-edge-1","max_tokens":32}'
```

Raj (eng-runtime): Heads up — the above will hit continuous-batching paths; if partners run parallel fans we should warn about queue depth. We'll add an autoscale hint to the manifest.

Sam (partnerships): Who can reach out to LangChain & LlamaIndex maintainers to confirm they want to join the slate? I'd like a thumbs-up before invites go out.

Emily (product): I'll take LangChain. Sam — can you ping LlamaIndex? We'll coordinate demo owners.

Morgan (bizops): I'll start the credits request and flag any PO/contract gating.

integrations-bot: Reminder: sandbox infra blackout window Thursday 03:00–04:00 UTC for host maintenance. Schedule invites accordingly.

Sam (partnerships): Cool — next steps: (1) Raj announces manifest PR, (2) Kai posts onboarding doc + quick-run snippets, (3) Partnerships sends invites Thurs, (4) Product & Marketing draft co-demo outline. I'll drop a short calendar invite. Anything missing?

Kai (devex): Please add SSO testcases to the manifest (SP & IdP flows). I'll mock an IdP for partners who can't do SAML.

Raj (eng-runtime): Also want HW partner contact list — need rack-level configs for on-prem tests. Sam can you attach contacts in the invite?

Sam (partnerships): Yup — will include contact list and a tiny acceptance checklist. Thanks all, will follow up in a short doc soon. :white_check_mark:
